name: kinship-desktop
description: Kinship 桌面端：加载远程 Web 应用并内置 PC 状态采集器
author: Xehuri

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.dist:win: npm run stage:pc-sensor && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.fallback.yml
